apiUnreachable: API unreachable — is the backend running on :8000?

use.classificationNoTarget: Assigns every new row to a category
use.regression: Estimates the value of "{{target}}" for every new row
use.regressionNoTarget: Estimates a numeric value for every new row
use.anomaly: Flags abnormal or suspicious rows, without labels
use.intrusion: Detects intrusions or hostile network traffic

bundleTitle: Standalone Python bundle (model + data + code + predict.py)
title: Trained models
note: All models built across every session. Identical re-trainings (same data, same algorithm) are grouped: only the most recent session is shown. Download the ready-to-serve .pkl, or open the session to inspect and rerun it.
runsTitle: {{n}} sessions for this data + algorithm pair — the most recent is shown
empty: No trained model yet. Complete the "Modelling" step of a session.
rlNote: Trained and saved reinforcement-learning agents (alert triage, patching, rerouting…). Stable-Baselines3 format (.zip) — trained and evaluated in the Reinforcement → Deep RL view.
rlEmpty: No saved agent yet. Train a base model in the Reinforcement → Deep RL view, then save it.
